 Order

Learned counsel for petitioners contends that in pursuance of acquisition of land belonging to the petitioners under the provisions of Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957 [for short "the Act of 1957"] proceedings are pending before the Part Time Tribunal, Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, Singrauli, since 2013.

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Part Time Tribunal, Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, Singrauli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, prays for a direction to take a final decision in the matter, as expeditiously as possible.

2. Having heard submissions advanced on behalf of the learned counsel for petitioners, as the issue pertaining to award of compensation under the provisions of the Act of 1957 is pending adjudication before the Part Time Tribunal, Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, Singrauli,
the present petition stands disposed of with a direction to the respondent No.4 to decide the compensation case of the petitioners, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
3.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is hereby made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on merits of the case.
The Tribunal in its own wisdom shall be at liberty to deal with the case in accordance with law.
